title: A Hot Pot Dinner
subtitle: 考点：Would you like…? / 一般现在时
passage: Sam is a new classmate from the UK. Today he visits Lin Tao's home. Lin Tao's mom makes hot pot and Mapo tofu. "Would you like some Mapo tofu, Sam?" asks Mom. "Yes, please! But is it hot?" "A little," says Lin Tao. Sam likes it very much.
"I'd like to visit China more," says Sam. "Maybe we can go to Beijing. We can eat Beijing roast duck and visit the Great Wall," says Lin Tao.
vocab: hot pot 火锅 · Mapo tofu 麻婆豆腐 · would like to 想要 · Beijing roast duck 北京烤鸭 · the Great Wall 长城 · country 国家
